KG hints","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Right-of-Way—When to Yield

FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A01
Right-of-way is given rather than taken, and drivers yield even when entitled whenever harm threatens [A01].
Why it matters: group given-not-taken; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A01
Children chase play into streets heedlessly, so drivers slow with extreme caution near schools, playgrounds, and homes [A01].
Why it matters: group children; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A01
Guide dogs and white, red-tipped, or chrome tapping canes mark blind crossers who own priority with a fifteen-foot halt zone [A01].
Why it matters: group blind-persons; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A01
The lead vehicle entering releases the whole headlight-lit procession through regardless of controls, and splitting the line is forbidden [A01].
Why it matters: group funeral; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A02
Stop signs order halting before the crosswalk, while yield signs order slowing to a reasonable halt-ready pace [A02].
Why it matters: group stop-vs-yield-sign; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec05-R06 | anchor: A02
Left turns wait out all oncoming traffic, and private entries halt at the sidewalk line before joining [A02].
Why it matters: group turns-and-entries; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec05-R07 | anchor: A02
Signaled emergency vehicles pull drivers right and clear, unsignaled ones earn no yield, and every roadside vehicle earns a leftward move or a slowdown [A02].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec05-R08 | anchor: A02
First in goes first, and simultaneous arrivals yield left to right [A02].
Why it matters: group four-way-order; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec05-R09 | anchor: A03
Bus holds release on rolling, waving, or lights-out, and only separate roadways, controlled-access loading zones, or divided-highway approaches excuse stopping [A03].
Why it matters: group bus-stop; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec05-F11 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-R10 | anchor: A03
Multi-lane drivers donate a buffer lane where safe, while two-lane drivers simply slow with care [A03].
Why it matters: group move-over; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F12 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-R11 | anchor: A03
Enter slow after scanning both ways plus left again, then accelerate clear without mid-turn braking [A03].
Why it matters: group intersection-entry; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F10 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-R12 | anchor: A04
Incident scenes demand alert cautious approaches with lane changes, slowing, obedience, and no rubbernecking [A04].
Why it matters: group tim-scene; difficulty low; prereq sec05-F12; confusables sec05-F13 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0031]
